race.description: Erin's Home Pastrol Company Mdn Plate
race.comment: PAULA (9) appeals as the key winning hope off her Doomben third, where she worked home into the money at long odds. Much improved effort there and now finds an easier assignment. Lovely set up. ALTO LUNA (1) is improving through the campaign and was also tested in metro grade last start, but has been beaten six and a half lengths at his past two and profiles more as a place hope than a clear winning threat. PIER ANGEL (10) comes through solid maiden racing and might appreciate the rise in trip. Keeping safe. VELA FORTUNE (11) started at big odds on debut last start when sixth, beaten 2.5 lengths, over 1400m at Gold Coast. Leading player with plenty of improvement in store.
